graham.brief:
Murray is priced for a role Minnesota hasn't given him yet. The books have Kyler Murray at 28.5 pass attempts, well above the 17 he's averaging. Minnesota is favored by 11 with a 38.5 total, and the books look for about 25 points from them. Somebody is early on Murray.

Miami's pass defense gives up more through the air than almost anyone, 2nd-worst in the league.

Miami has struggled when the defense sends extra rushers, and Minnesota sends extra rushers more than most. Malik Willis is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps. Murray's 28.5 pass attempts line is where the books put the center of his range, and about half his likely games land on each side of it.

What I can't see is why Murray's line sits that far from what he's done. Track Miami's throws over the first two series, because the usual share keeps the matchup alive while an early run tilt says it never opened.
